coverage: 2000-present: official State Register web indexes from January 2016, plus 36 weather declarations added by hand: 4 by Governor Foster (2000-2003), from his executive order printed in the Louisiana Register and dated news coverage, 13 by Governors Blanco and Jindal (2004-2015), from proclamations cited in the Louisiana Register and dated news coverage, and 19 by Governor Edwards (2016-2023). No state declaration was found for DR-1357 (December 2000 ice storm), DR-1521 (May 2004), DR-1601 (Cindy, 2005), DR-1668 (October 2006) or DR-4228 (Red River flooding, 2015); plus 15 weather declarations from FMCSA's archive of state emergency declarations (2017-present)
